harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Enabled and persisted firewalld on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) to allow only SSH and TCP 8080, rejecting all other inbound traffic; verified functionally, then completed the mandatory single-node restart with boot-identity and recovery proof.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS, firewall tooling, and listening ports (firewalld active, only ssh/cockpit/dhcpv6-client allowed)
Removed cockpit and dhcpv6-client services from the public zone (permanent)
Added ssh service and 8080/tcp port to the public zone (permanent), reloaded firewalld, ensured firewalld is enabled at boot
Verified persisted config via --list-all and --permanent --list-all
Inspected nftables ruleset showing explicit reject (icmpx admin-prohibited) for unmatched inbound traffic on enp1s0
Functionally tested: started a listener on 8080, confirmed SSH(22) and 8080 open, confirmed unrelated port (12345) actively refused, via /dev/tcp probes against NODE_IP
Cleaned up test listener
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, firewalld active+enabled, sshd active
Triggered systemctl reboot on node1 via backgrounded delayed command so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; confirmed boot_id changed (new value), proving actual restart
Verified post-restart: firewalld active+enabled, rules persisted (ssh + 8080/tcp only), sshd active
Re-ran functional connectivity test post-restart: SSH and 8080 open, unrelated port 12345 refused
Cleaned up test artifacts

evidence.summary: Showed firewalld active with only cockpit/dhcpv6-client/ssh allowed, no 8080 rule, listening services on 22 and 9090

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall rule permitting SSH and 8080, removing unrelated services
evidence.summary: Applied --permanent changes (removed cockpit/dhcpv6-client, added ssh+8080/tcp), reloaded, enabled firewalld; --list-all and --permanent --list-all confirm zone now allows exactly ssh + 8080/tcp
nftables ruleset shows explicit reject-with-icmpx-admin-prohibited for unmatched traffic; live test with 8080 listener running shows SSH and 8080 OPEN while port 12345 is actively refused

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4d340bf4-0579-47f0-98c1-5c17a66d50f1, firewalld active+enabled, sshd active before reboot
Backgrounded delayed systemctl reboot command acknowledged successfully before node disconnected
Polling sequence shows node unreachable during reboot, then reachable again with new boot_id 5c30b7a6-c55d-493b-bc9b-d02b29d6d2da, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of firewall config and services
evidence.summary: After restart, firewalld is active and enabled, zone config still shows only ssh + 8080/tcp permitted, sshd active

evidence.requirement: Post-restart functional verification of firewall behavior
evidence.summary: Re-tested after restart: SSH and 8080 (live listener) open, unrelated port 12345 refused; test listener cleaned up

attempts.summary: Enabled and persisted firewalld on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) to allow only SSH and TCP 8080, rejecting all other inbound traffic; verified functionally, then completed the mandatory single-node restart with boot-identity and recovery proof.
